description: Search the projects Pulse follows by words in their name, description or topics, by area (ckb, fiber, dob/spore, rgb++, ccc, nervos), or both; the most active first. Counts every update, with no cap on bursts, so numbers can be higher than on the page and in overview.

limit.description: at most this many, 15 by default

offset.description: skip this many, to read the next page

query.description: words to look for, e.g. "wallet" or "lock script"; all words must match, "a OR b" takes either; plurals and hyphens do not matter

sort.description: updates (the default), commits, people, stars or recent (latest update first)

name: find_projects
title: Find CKB projects
